title: Slovakian Potatoes With Old Fashioned Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful dish combining the traditional Slovakian flavors with the comfort of an old fashioned bake.
instructions: Peel and dice the Slovakian potatoes.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, vegetable oil, onion, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. Toss until the potatoes are evenly coated.
Transfer the potato mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Crumble the old fashioned bake over the potato mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
